## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests.
- [ ] I updated documentation or examples if needed.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm test`.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build`.
- [ ] Dataset changes include provenance and license notes.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private data, or misleading adoption claims.

## Notes for reviewers

Mention edge cases, limitations, or follow-up work.
